hints.title: Fixed String Slice
hints.text: In each passenger string of length 15, characters at indices 11 and 12 represent the passenger's age.

hints.title: Integer Parsing
hints.text: Parse substring [11:13] into an integer and check whether it strictly exceeds 60.

hints.title: Count Over Threshold
hints.text: Count how many passenger strings satisfy the condition age > 60.

hints.title: Substring Filter Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass checking 2-character slice per passenger.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear slice check is the simplest possible approach.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct index slicing without regex overhead.
